author: IcyCode
body:
I have made this to encourage other people to make other maps other than Nebula DTM as sooooo many people make them. These are ALL the gamemodes (Of which you can currently make maps for) in avicus with a description including sub-gamemodes:
  • Nebula - 2 Team Matches Of Intense PVP:
    • DTM (Destroy The Monument) - Attempt to destroy the other teams monument(s) to win the game! - Example Kingdom
    • TDM (Team Death Match) - 10 minute long matches where your team aims to get the highest score. These sometimes have added features like TNT and Score Boxes :D - Example TNT Warz
    • NEW OiTN (One In The Nebula) - Same as TDM but with one hit kill equipment like One In the Chamber - Example Cleyra
  • NEW Nexus - Up to 4 teams in a non stop pvp battle with kits. Each battle lasts 10 minutes then immediately another starts - Example Canyon
  • Control The Hill - Try to get your team to take control of the hill by killing anyone. When the countdown begins stand on the hill to get points for your team. First team to reach the point limit wins! - Example Lectura
  • Walls - 10 Minutes of preparation time then the walls drop. The aim is to kill everybody else on the 3 other teams... - Example Mini Classic
  • Avicade - A variety of quick, on going minigames cycle:
    • Minotour - Escape from the minotour who has 1 hit kill and speed. Be the first one to the finish line to get XP - Example Hazardous
    • OITC (One In The Chamber) - Get as many kills as possible equipped with a one shot kill bow with only one arrow and an axe - Example Rats
    • Red Alert - Last man standing on the 1 block high terrain which falls behind you! - Example Incendio
    • More Coming Soon!
I really hope this helps anybody thinking about making a map as we want more variety available! I also hope this gets people playing other gamemodes other than standard Nebula the whole time :D

Note: If I have missed a gamemode please add it in the comments below
